hints.invalidAccessToken: Solution: The Access Token may have expired. Please log in to the site again, then in 'Account Management → Edit Account', automatically re-identify/refresh the Access Token. If this issue still occurs after automatic identification, please manually obtain and modify the Access Token.
hints.manualVerificationRequired: Try clicking "Open site" first, then complete login, Turnstile, PoW, or other basic verification on the site so the browser has a valid session before retrying auto check-in. If it still fails repeatedly after verification, the current auto check-in flow may not support this site yet, so use manual sign-in for now.
hints.noTabWithId: Tip: Don't close any tab/window opened automatically by the extension. The extension will close them after a short time. If you must close them manually, wait at least 1 minute before closing.
hints.openExternalCheckIn: Open unchecked external check-ins by default. Ctrl/Cmd opens all; Shift opens in a new window.
hints.openFailedManualNewWindow: Open the site check-in page for every account whose latest auto check-in failed. Shift-click to open them in a new window.
hints.siteTypeCheckinUnsupported: Solution: in 'Account Management → Edit Account', confirm the site type matches the real site. A page title can be a generic shell (New API, for example) while the deployment itself runs a different backend, so auto-detection can pick the wrong type. If the type was auto-detected, log back into the target site and detect again, or pick the correct type yourself, then run once more. If the type is right and check-in still fails, the site likely does not support automatic check-in yet — use 'Open site' or 'Manual sign-in' instead.
hints.siteTypeMismatch: This site matches {{suggestedType}}, which differs from the selected Site Type {{storedType}}. Set the Site Type in 'Edit Account' to {{suggestedType}}, then run again.

providerFallback.checkinFailed: Check-in failed and the site did not say why. Try again later, or check in manually.
providerFallback.endpointNotSupported: This site has no check-in method the extension can use, which usually means the account's Site Type does not match the real site.
providerFallback.loginProviderRequired: This account has no check-in login method selected. Choose one in the account's Edit dialog, then retry.
providerFallback.nativePageIdentityMismatch: The check-in page opened for this site was signed in as a different account, not the account you are checking in. Sign in to this site with that account, then retry: {{checkInUrl}}
providerFallback.nativePageIdentityMissing: The extension opened this site's check-in page but could not tell which account was signed in. Sign in to this site with the account you are checking in, then retry; if this keeps happening, re-detect the account in its Edit dialog: {{checkInUrl}}
providerFallback.nativePageStatusUnconfirmed: The extension clicked check-in on the page, but could not confirm that the site recorded it. Open that page to check today's status, and check in manually if needed: {{checkInUrl}}
providerFallback.nativePageTargetNotFound: No check-in button was found on this site's check-in page (the page may still be loading, or the site has changed). Open that page and check in manually: {{checkInUrl}}
providerFallback.nativePageTriggerFailed: The extension could not click the check-in button on this site's check-in page (the page may be slow, or the action was temporarily limited). Open that page and check in manually: {{checkInUrl}}
providerFallback.sessionBusy: Another login is already in progress. Try again later.
providerFallback.turnstileIncognitoAccessRequired: Another account is already signed in to this site, so the extension needs an Incognito window to open this account's check-in page, but it is not allowed to run in Incognito. Allow the extension in Incognito from your browser's extension settings and retry, or complete the verification on the check-in page yourself: {{checkInUrl}}
providerFallback.turnstileManualRequired: This site requires a human verification step (Cloudflare Turnstile) that you have to pass on the page; the extension cannot do it for you. Open the check-in page below, complete it, then retry: {{checkInUrl}}
providerFallback.unknownError: Something went wrong. Try again later.

settings.deterministicTimeDesc: Pick the exact time (HH:mm) to start check-in when deterministic mode is enabled.
settings.enableDesc: Controls global automatic check-ins. When disabled, scheduled and other automatic tasks stop, but manual check-in actions remain available.
settings.notifyUiOnCompletion: Refresh data and interface upon auto check-in completion
settings.notifyUiOnCompletionDesc: When automatic check-in is completed, immediately refresh the check-in account's data and relevant interfaces.
settings.pretriggerDailyOnUiOpen: Pre-trigger daily run when UI opens
settings.pretriggerDailyOnUiOpenDesc: When you open the extension UI during today's time window and the daily run has not executed yet, start it immediately.
settings.retryDesc: Automatically retry failed and unconfirmed results later the same day, except clear dead ends.
settings.retryIntervalDesc: How long to wait before the next retry attempt.
settings.retryMaxAttemptsDesc: Max attempts per account per day (initial + retries).
settings.scheduleModeDesc: Choose how the next run time inside the window is calculated.
settings.title: Auto Check-in
settings.viewExecutionDesc: View completed auto check-in results, skip reasons, and account readiness. This is not a pending account list.
settings.windowEndDesc: The latest local time when the daily check-in can start.
settings.windowStartDesc: The earliest local time when the daily check-in can start.

skipReasons.account_data_missing: Required account details are missing. Re-detect the account in its Edit dialog.
skipReasons.account_disabled: This account is disabled; enable it again in its Edit dialog.
skipReasons.account_state_write_failed: The updated account sign-in could not be saved. Check extension storage and retry manually.
skipReasons.account_unavailable: The account changed or became unavailable before check-in. Refresh the account and retry.
skipReasons.authentication_required: Your sign-in has expired or is missing. Sign in to this site with this account, then retry.
skipReasons.auto_checkin_disabled: Auto check-in is off (the global switch or this account's switch).
skipReasons.checkin_page_unavailable: The site's check-in page could not be opened. Try again later, or check in manually.
skipReasons.checkin_unconfirmed: The site did not confirm the check-in request. Try again later.
skipReasons.credentials_missing: Sign-in credentials are missing. Update or re-detect the account in its Edit dialog.
skipReasons.detection_disabled: Check-in detection is off for this account.
skipReasons.execution_context_invalid: This run could not get a usable signed-in session. Start the check-in again.
skipReasons.login_provider_in_use: This login method is already used by another AgentRouter account. Pick another or adjust that account.
skipReasons.login_provider_required: No login method is selected. Choose the method this account signs in with in its settings.
skipReasons.manual_verification_required: The site requires you to pass a human verification step first.
skipReasons.method_disabled: This site currently has check-in turned off.
skipReasons.method_not_matched: The check-in method no longer matches this site. Re-detect it.
skipReasons.method_unavailable: The selected check-in method is unavailable. Re-detect it.
skipReasons.method_unsupported: This site does not support the selected check-in method. Re-detect or pick another.
skipReasons.network_error: The network connection failed and check-in did not finish. Check your connection and retry.
skipReasons.no_provider: This account's site type does not support auto check-in yet.
skipReasons.no_selected_method: No check-in method is selected. Re-detect or select one in the account's Edit dialog.
skipReasons.permission_denied: The site refused the check-in. Sign in to the site again and retry.
skipReasons.session_busy: Another login is already in progress. Try again later.
skipReasons.source_unavailable: The site is temporarily unavailable. Try again later.
skipReasons.status_unavailable: Today's check-in status could not be read, so nothing ran to avoid a duplicate.
skipReasons.timeout: The connection timed out before check-in finished. Try again later.
skipReasons.upstream_error: The site returned a result the extension could not recognize, so check-in success is unknown.
skipReasons.upstream_rejected: The site refused this check-in request.
